title: Spreadsheet Template Zones
description: Three zones in a tracking spreadsheet, and why the order of the columns is not arbitrary.
creator: Coding Club
author: Dan McCreary
subject: Coding Club
chapter_title: Tracking Student Data and Managing Club Communication

pedagogical.learningObjective: Given a column from a tracking spreadsheet, the learner classifies which template zone it belongs to and why.
pedagogical.interactionPattern: Click any zone to see which columns belong to it and why
